description.value: Blundell Market is a supermarket located in Richmond, BC on Number 3 Road, serving the surrounding residential community. It accepts both cash and credit cards, making it accessible to cyclists who may carry either form of payment. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's cycling network would find it a convenient provisioning stop.
